question: Virù S.A. brand manufacturer avocado oil
markdown:
Virú S.A.
is a major agro-industrial company based in Peru that ranks as one of the country's leading cultivators, processors, and bulk exporters of agricultural goods, including premium avocado oil. The company operates large-scale agricultural production and advanced extraction facilities to supply international markets.
UN Global Compact
Company and Operations
Location:
Headquartered in Trujillio/Lima, Peru.
Core Business:
Agro-industrial processing, canned and frozen foods, and bulk vegetable oils.
Avocado Operations:
Cultivates large fields of avocados and utilizes mechanical extraction (such as centrifugation and cold-processing) to produce bulk avocado oil.
UN Global Compact
Product Offerings
Bulk Supply:
Primarily distributes extra virgin and virgin avocado oil in large-scale commercial quantities (such as flexitanks or drums) rather than direct-to-consumer retail bottle labels.
Instagram
La Tourangelle Artisan Oils
B2B Focus:
Acts as a wholesale supplier and global exporter for international food brands, cosmetic companies, and ingredient distributors.
